subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Talos AI (next steps)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — Talos AI (next steps)

Hi Sophie — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the productive discovery; I wanted to summarize the key points and propose next steps so we can size Dedicated capacity for Talos.

Quick summary from our call:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + contextual retrieval for knowledge base.
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~10k requests/day, ~15 tokens per request average (short prompts), ~150 response tokens average.
- Peak: up to ~250 requests/minute during morning wave (~4x steady).
- Target latency: p95 <= 250ms for user-facing responses; some background batch jobs can tolerate higher.
- Model: leaning toward Llama-2 13B (quantized) or a Redwood-verified 13B variant.
- Data sensitivity: PII in prompts; will require Private deployment or strict data retention controls.

To size Dedicated for throughput and latency we typically need a short technical deep dive with one of our solutions engineers. Can we schedule a 45-minute capacity-sizing call next week? During that call Marissa (SRE/solutions) will go over:
- Expected concurrency distribution and p95 latency SLOs by route
- Burst profiles and typical session lengths
- Tokenization and example prompts to estimate KV cache hit rates
- Any constraints (VPC, egress, KMS) for Private/Dedicated

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue, Nov 24 — 10:00–10:45am or 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed, Nov 25 — 9:30–10:15am

If those don't work, send a couple of slots that do and also, if possible, attach a simple traffic export (CSV or spreadsheet) with timestamps and sample prompt/response lengths — that helps us run a quick cost/throughput model before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
